title: Anonymous captcha height parameter drives EasyCaptcha BufferedImage heap allocation
sink: EruptUserController.createCode -> new SpecCaptcha(150, height, 4) -> captcha.out(); EasyCaptcha SpecCaptcha.graphicsImage creates BufferedImage(width,height,TYPE_INT_RGB)
retention: Large image object is retained during request rendering/encoding; verification code text is stored separately with 60 second TTL and local LRU capacity 100000
bound: No application-level max height. Endpoint is anonymous because it has no EruptRouter/LoginAuth/MenuAuth annotation. Query string only needs a short numeric value.
evidence: EasyCaptcha 1.6.2 javap: SpecCaptcha.graphicsImage calls new BufferedImage(width,height,1)
exploitability: Default external HTTP request can cause very large transient heap allocation. Needs runtime measurement to prove OOM/GC death/service unavailability threshold.
static_status: No dynamic test run; static source-to-sink path is concrete.
